comparison.objective: Load a thin card under a clipboard clip, square and against its stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring lever open with one hand while friction-sliding and aligning a thin sheet with the other.
comparison.success_condition: Card is spring-clamped, aligned and fully inserted, survives a 60-degree board tilt with at most 3 mm slip, and both hands are clear.
comparison.reason: The common bimanual asymmetry is generic; spring actuation plus sheet sliding is not selective sifting under changing loose-body load. No material rubric details are missing.
